---
title: "Compare Gravel Bikes"
editor: source
---

::: {.callout-note}
1. The classification was computed using a robust [k-means method](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K-means_clustering){target="_blank"}.
2. The classification is based on a frame size that fits a 175 cm high rider (generally frame size M or 54), according to manufacturer's charts.
:::

```{r setup-gravel-style, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      knitr.kable.NA = '')
source_path <- here::here("bike_geometry_project.R")
source(source_path)

```


```{r working, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
specs_cols <- c("kmeans_style", "material", "fork", "handlebar", "stack", "reach", "chainstay_length", "front_center", "bottom_bracket_drop", "trail", "trail_45", "udh", "seatpost_diameter", "tire_width_max_700c", "tire_width_max_650b", "fork_class", "axle_spacing", "dropout", "internal_storage", "fork_suspension", "stem_suspension", "rear_suspension", "base_build_usd", "frameset_usd")
keep_cols <- c("model_size", specs_cols)
specs_long <- geobike[, .SD, .SDcols = keep_cols]
# specs_long[, row := .I]

specs <- dcast(specs_long, model_size ~. , value.var = specs_cols) |>
  transpose(make.names = "model_size", keep.names = "spec")

col1 <- melt(bike_table,
             id.vars = "model_size",
             measure.vars = keep_cols[-1])
col1 <- col1[order(model_size)]
col1 <- col1[, c(1,3)]

col2 <- col1
```
